featured_reviews.review_text:
Beware of their late-night fuel scam. If you visit this HP pump at night, the attendants will conveniently tell you that "normal petrol is out of stock" and force you to fill up with the more expensive 'Power' petrol.
​However, magically by morning—when people have other open fuel stations to choose from—the normal petrol is suddenly back in stock without any new tankers arriving. They are deliberately creating artificial scarcity at night to exploit customers who are low on fuel and have no other options. Highly unethical business practices. Avoid visiting this pump after hours unless you want to be forced into paying a premium.

⭐⭐⭐⭐ Shell Petrol Pump — Customer Feedback
Visited this Shell petrol pump recently and overall it was a decent experience with a few things that stood out both positively and as areas to work on.
What Impressed ✅
Fuel Quality — Shell’s fuel quality is consistently reliable and you can feel the difference in engine performance. No complaints whatsoever on that front — it justifies the brand’s premium reputation.
Staff Behaviour — The attendants were polite, prompt, and professional. They greeted well, filled the correct quantity without any funny business, and even checked tyre pressure on request without attitude. Refreshing to see.
Cleanliness — The forecourt and surroundings were noticeably clean and well-maintained compared to many local pumps. The Shell brand standard clearly shows here.
Areas to Improve 🔧
Waiting Time — During peak morning and evening hours the queue builds up quite fast. Additional service lanes or faster billing would greatly improve the experience.
Restroom Condition — The washroom facility, though present, needs more frequent upkeep. For a premium brand like Shell, the restroom standards should match the overall image.
Air & Water Station — The free air and water facility was non-functional during my visit. This is a basic expectation at any pump and should be kept operational at all times.
Digital Payment — UPI and card payment process was slightly slow. A faster and smoother payment terminal upgrade would be appreciated.
Loyalty Programme Awareness — Staff could be better trained to inform customers about Shell’s loyalty or rewards programme. Many customers are unaware of the benefits available.
Overall
A trustworthy and clean fuel stop that lives up to the Shell name for the most part. Small operational improvements can easily make this a 5-star experience. Would recommend for quality-conscious motorists. ⛽​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

Poor and Unethical Service at Petrol Pump

I had a very disappointing experience at this petrol pump. I clearly asked the attendant to fill petrol worth ₹210, but instead, he filled petrol for ₹410. The major issue was that he did not reset the fuel meter to zero before starting. The previous customer had filled ₹125 worth of petrol, and instead of resetting the meter, the attendant continued from that amount.

To make things worse, the display light on the fuel machine was not working, making it very difficult to see the meter reading clearly, especially in daylight or low visibility conditions. This made it easy for them to mislead customers and overcharge.

This kind of behavior is unethical and creates distrust among customers. Petrol pumps must ensure:
•	Meter is always reset to zero before each transaction
•	All machines are fully functional and visible
•	Staff are transparent and honest with customers

I hope the management takes strict action and improves their service. I also urge other customers to be cautious and always double-check before filling fuel.
